can_do_en: I can check in at a clinic with my health insurance card, tell the doctor what's wrong and for how long, and understand how to take my medicine.

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，我要看病。這是我的健保卡。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄅㄨˋ ㄏㄠˇ ㄧˋ ˙ㄙ ㄨㄛˇ ㄧㄠˋ ㄎㄢˋ ㄅㄧㄥˋ ㄓㄜˋ ㄕˋ ㄨㄛˇ ˙ㄉㄜ ㄐㄧㄢˋ ㄅㄠˇ ㄎㄚˇ
dialogue.en: Excuse me, I'd like to see the doctor. Here's my health insurance card.

dialogue.speaker: 護士
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄏㄠˇ ㄋㄧˇ ㄕˋ ㄉㄧˋ ㄧ ㄘˋ ㄌㄞˊ ˙ㄇㄚ
dialogue.en: OK. Is this your first time here?

dialogue.speaker: 護士
dialogue.zh: 好，你是十五號。請在那邊坐一下，等一下會叫你的名字。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄏㄠˇ ㄋㄧˇ ㄕˋ ㄕˊ ㄨˇ ㄏㄠˋ ㄑㄧㄥˇ ㄗㄞˋ ㄋㄚˋ ㄅㄧㄢ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄧ ㄒㄧㄚˋ ㄉㄥˇ ㄧ ㄒㄧㄚˋ ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄐㄧㄠˋ ㄋㄧˇ ˙ㄉㄜ ㄇㄧㄥˊ ˙ㄗ
dialogue.en: OK, you're number 15. Please have a seat over there; we'll call your name in a moment.

dialogue.speaker: 醫生
dialogue.zh: 你好，怎麼了？哪裡不舒服？
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄋㄧˇ ㄏㄠˇ ㄗㄣˇ ˙ㄇㄜ ˙ㄌㄜ ㄋㄚˇ ㄌㄧˇ ㄅㄨˋ ㄕㄨ ˙ㄈㄨ
dialogue.en: Hello. What's wrong? Where don't you feel well?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 我喉嚨很痛，還一直咳嗽。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄏㄡˊ ㄌㄨㄥˊ ㄏㄣˇ ㄊㄨㄥˋ ㄏㄞˊ ㄧ ㄓˊ ㄎㄜˊ ㄙㄡˋ
dialogue.en: My throat really hurts, and I keep coughing.

dialogue.speaker: 醫生
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄊㄨㄥˋ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄐㄧㄡˇ ˙ㄌㄜ ㄧㄡˇ ㄈㄚ ㄕㄠ ˙ㄇㄚ
dialogue.en: How long has it hurt? Do you have a fever?

dialogue.speaker: 馬克
dialogue.zh: 已經痛了兩天了。昨天晚上好像有一點發燒。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄧˇ ㄐㄧㄥ ㄊㄨㄥˋ ˙ㄌㄜ ㄌㄧㄤˇ ㄊㄧㄢ ˙ㄌㄜ ㄗㄨㄛˊ ㄊㄧㄢ ㄨㄢˇ ㄕㄤˋ ㄏㄠˇ ㄒㄧㄤˋ ㄧㄡˇ ㄧ ㄉㄧㄢˇ ㄈㄚ ㄕㄠ
dialogue.en: It's been hurting for two days now. Last night I think I had a bit of a fever.

dialogue.speaker: 醫生
dialogue.zh: 我看一下你的喉嚨……有點紅，是感冒喔。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄎㄢˋ ㄧ ㄒㄧㄚˋ ㄋㄧˇ ˙ㄉㄜ ㄏㄡˊ ㄌㄨㄥˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄉㄧㄢˇ ㄏㄨㄥˊ ㄕˋ ㄍㄢˇ ㄇㄠˋ ㄛ
dialogue.en: Let me take a look at your throat… It's a bit red. It's a cold.

dialogue.speaker: 醫生
dialogue.zh: 不嚴重啦。我開三天的藥給你，一天吃三次，飯後吃。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄅㄨˋ ㄧㄢˊ ㄓㄨㄥˋ ˙ㄌㄚ ㄨㄛˇ ㄎㄞ ㄙㄢ ㄊㄧㄢ ˙ㄉㄜ ㄧㄠˋ ㄍㄟˇ ㄋㄧˇ ㄧ ㄊㄧㄢ ㄔ ㄙㄢ ㄘˋ ㄈㄢˋ ㄏㄡˋ ㄔ
dialogue.en: It's not serious. I'll give you three days of medicine: three times a day, after meals.

dialogue.speaker: 醫生
dialogue.zh: 這幾天要多喝水、多休息，不要喝冰的喔。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄐㄧˇ ㄊㄧㄢ ㄧㄠˋ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄏㄜ ㄕㄨㄟˇ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄒㄧㄡ ㄒㄧˊ ㄅㄨˋ ㄧㄠˋ ㄏㄜ ㄅㄧㄥ ˙ㄉㄜ ㄛ
dialogue.en: For the next few days, drink plenty of water and get lots of rest. And no cold drinks, OK?

dialogue.speaker: 護士
dialogue.zh: 馬克先生，這是你的藥和健保卡。一共一百五十塊。
dialogue.zhuyin: ㄇㄚˇ ㄎㄜˋ ㄒㄧㄢ ㄕㄥ ㄓㄜˋ ㄕˋ ㄋㄧˇ ˙ㄉㄜ ㄧㄠˋ ㄏㄜˊ ㄐㄧㄢˋ ㄅㄠˇ ㄎㄚˇ ㄧ ㄍㄨㄥˋ ㄧ ㄅㄞˇ ㄨˇ ㄕˊ ㄎㄨㄞˋ
dialogue.en: Mr. Mark, here are your medicine and your health insurance card. That's 150 dollars altogether.

grammar.note_en: The doctor opens with 怎麼了？哪裡不舒服？, the everyday way to ask what's wrong. A friend who sees you looking ill would say 你怎麼了？
痛了兩天了: the length of time goes after the verb, and the final 了 says it is still going on. It answers the doctor's 痛多久了？
The doctor says the throat is 有點紅, and Mark softens his symptom with 有一點發燒: 'a bit', for something unwelcome.

pronunciation.note_en: Keep three sounds apart: ㄒ in 休息 ㄒㄧㄡ ㄒㄧˊ (tongue tip down, lips spread), ㄕ in 發燒 ㄈㄚ ㄕㄠ and 舒服 ㄕㄨ ˙ㄈㄨ (tongue tip up behind the gum ridge), and ㄙ in 咳嗽 ㄎㄜˊ ㄙㄡˋ and 三次 ㄙㄢ ㄘˋ (a plain s). Many Taiwan speakers say ㄕ close to ㄙ; understand it, but produce ㄕ. Tone pair 2+4 (rise, then a high fall): 咳嗽, 嚴重. 一共 is written ㄧ ㄍㄨㄥˋ but said ㄧˊ ㄍㄨㄥˋ, the same 2+4 shape, and 不要 is said ㄅㄨˊ ㄧㄠˋ.

speaking.prompt_en: You're at a clinic in Pingtung. Tell the doctor where you don't feel well, how long it has lasted, and whether you have a fever. Then ask if it's serious.
speaking.prompt_zh: 你去看醫生。請跟醫生說你哪裡不舒服、不舒服多久了、有沒有發燒，然後問醫生嚴不嚴重。
checklist_en: said what hurts or where you feel unwell (我……很痛 / 不舒服)
put the length of time after the verb (痛了兩天了)
used 有一點 or 有點 for a mild symptom
kept ㄒ (休息), ㄕ (發燒) and ㄙ (咳嗽) apart

writing.prompt_en: You're sick today. Write a short LINE message (3–5 sentences) to your boss: what's wrong, how long it has lasted, that you saw a doctor, and that you can't come to work.
writing.prompt_zh: 你今天生病了。請寫一個短短的LINE訊息跟老闆說：你怎麼了、多久了、有沒有去看醫生，還有今天不能去上班。
writing.model_zh: 老闆，不好意思，我感冒了，今天不能去上班。我喉嚨很痛，已經咳了兩天了，昨天晚上還有一點發燒。早上我去看醫生了，醫生說要多休息。明天再跟您說，謝謝！

culture_en: Taiwan's National Health Insurance (全民健保) covers almost everyone who lives here, and each insured person has an IC card with a photo, the 健保卡. Hand it in at the counter every time you see a doctor: the clinic registers you (掛號), and you pay a registration fee (掛號費) set by the clinic plus a fixed copayment (部分負擔). Many neighbourhood clinics give you a number and show the number now being seen on a display, and they often hand you the medicine right there, in a bag that tells you how many times a day to take it and whether before or after meals (飯前 / 飯後). Foreign residents with a residence permit (ARC) can join after six months in Taiwan; people employed in Taiwan join from their first day of work.
